scripts.lint: cd frontend && expo lint -- --max-warnings 0 && npx tsc --noEmit
scripts.lint:backend: cd backend && npm run lint && npm run type-check
scripts.lint:ml: uv run --no-project --with-requirements backend/python/requirements-dev.txt ruff check backend/services/ml backend/scripts backend/python backend/python_tests
scripts.lint:python-types: cd backend/python && uv run --no-project --with-requirements requirements-dev.txt mypy . && cd ../services/ml && uv run --no-project --with-requirements ../../python/requirements-dev.txt mypy .
scripts.lint:docs:links: command -v lychee > /dev/null 2>&1 && lychee --no-progress '*.md' 'docs/**/*.md' || echo 'Install lychee (https://github.com/lycheeverse/lychee) for local link checking'
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:ml && npm run lint:docs && npm run lint:python-types && npx knip --exclude unlisted,binaries,types && npm run test -- --coverage && npm run test:backend -- --coverage && npm run test:python && npm run check:admin && npm run verify:bundles --workspace=news-investor-backend && ./scripts/check-console-calls.sh && npm run check:sync
scripts.lint:admin: cd admin && npm run lint && npm run type-check
scripts.check:admin: if [ -d admin ]; then npm run lint:admin && npm run test:admin && npm run build:admin; else echo 'admin/ absent (community edition) - skipping admin lint, tests and build'; fi
scripts.check:sync: if [ -d .sync ]; then ./scripts/check-sync-filter-coverage.py && ./scripts/overlay-staleness.sh && ./scripts/sync-leak-audit.sh && ./scripts/check-overlay-autofix-safety.sh; else echo '.sync/ absent (community edition) - skipping the sync guards'; fi
